line.comment: * Called by Mayhem.GameCreator.SpawnPirates upon gamestart and by ZH.Pirate.CheckBaseSpawn (in turn called by ZH.Monitor) to re-spawn pirate bases periodically.
* Add-Ons 2.0.4: This is now the SSOT for Pirate Base spawning.
* 1. Pirate Bases now spawn within a 3D outer shell instead of four corner regions.
* 2. Each axis is strictly bounded to +/-100 km, with a preferred radial distance of 110-140 km.
* 3. Rejection sampling succeeds approximately 29% per attempt; 30 attempts gives >99.99% success.
* The last bounded candidate is used in the extremely unlikely event that all attempts fail.
* Add-Ons 2.1.3: Now uses a helper script to determine radial position.
* Mordan8 - Set local variable on Pirate station indicating whether it will spawn a Pirate Warlord upon destruction of the station.
* Doing this at Station Creation time prevents save-scumming in order to get a warlord.
* Expanded 2.2: Warlords can use M2s on Hard and Insane.
* Add-Ons 1.12.2: Resource is now randomized. (2.0.4: Increased chance of silicon: 25% -> 50%.)
